activity_summary: You set the sharp page aside and wrote a shorter letter. Anne is to judge what the house must pay before you come. You name no day, and you have not bespoken the horse. The sheet is not given to a carrier.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the shorter letter and left the day unsaid.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: What must be paid before then, you judge.
